variants.text: Young adult male with an oval face, square jawline, thick straight eyebrows, and short stubble.
Young adult male with an oval face shape, square jawline, and thick straight eyebrows. He has an almond-shaped eye structure and short stubble on his upper lip, chin, and jawline.

Young adult male with an oval face, moderate soft tissue, and prominent bone structure. Features include a medium forehead with slight temporal recession, thick straight eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes with a double lid crease. The nose has a straight dorsum and bulbous tip. The jaw is broad and square with a rounded chin. Short stubble covers the upper lip, chin, and jawline. Ears have free lobes.

A young guy with an oval face and a strong, square jaw. He has thick, straight eyebrows and a bit of stubble on his chin and jawline. His nose is fairly prominent with a rounded tip, and he has almond-shaped eyes.
